title: Issue Groomer Output
description: Output contract for the `issue-groomer` agent. One object per goal (one groomed issue). The agent loops autonomously through status-less open issues, exhaustively grooming each one and applying status:ready (clear path) or status:blocked (fully groomed, path-decision needed), then continuing to the next.

goal_id.description: Unique identifier for this goal instance, e.g. 'goal-groomer-2026-001'.

groom_status.description: Outcome of this grooming cycle. 'ready' = issue fully groomed with clear implementation path, status:ready applied; 'blocked' = exhaustively groomed but a genuine product/path decision is needed by a human, status:blocked applied; 'skipped' = issue already had a status label (no grooming needed); 'terminal' = no more status-less issues to groom; 'failed' = operational/budget failure that prevented grooming completion (NOT a product decision — retry after adjusting limits).

issue_number.description: GitHub issue number that was groomed.

issue_url.description: Full URL of the GitHub issue, e.g. 'https://github.com/acme/myapp/issues/73'.

claim_evidence.description: Best-effort claim evidence; the label-swap claim is non-atomic in v1 (sequential/single-instance only). Records the status-less -> status:grooming transition attempt before grooming began.

label_swap_confirmed.description: True if the status:grooming label was applied to claim the issue.

self_assign_confirmed.description: True if the issue was self-assigned to prevent double-pickup.

template_used.description: The issue template name used for grooming (e.g. 'feature-slice', 'bug-regression'), or a fallback note like 'fallback: feature-ticket-format' if the target repo has no .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ directory.

codebase_grounding.description: Evidence of deep codebase research performed before drafting the groomed issue body.

verified_paths.description: Real file paths verified to exist in the target repository codebase.

docs_read.description: Product and context documents read during research (e.g. product-vision.md, repo-practices.md).

dor_checklist_results.description: Definition of Ready checklist items with pass/fail/na status. The DOR is the groomer's exit gate — producing exactly what the implementer's ground/intake phase needs.

assumptions_made.description: Documented assumptions made during grooming, with rationale for each.

alternatives_considered.description: Implementation alternatives researched and analyzed, with a recommendation flag. Required for groom_status:blocked (minItems:1). Encouraged for groom_status:ready when multiple viable paths were considered.

ui_ux_notes.description: User-facing UX observations and constraints for this issue: how the change should feel to the user, error states, loading states, non-breaking UX invariants, and any accessibility or visual consistency notes.

escalation_reason.description: Required when groom_status=blocked. Specific description of the genuine product/path decision that needs a human. Must be actionable — describe what needs to be decided, not just that a decision is needed. minLength:1 ensures the string is non-empty.

skip_reason.description: Required when groom_status=skipped. Reason the issue was skipped — typically that it already had a non-status-less label (e.g. status:in-progress, status:ready) when selected.

run_stop_reason.description: Required when groom_status=terminal. Reason the agent loop stopped. 'max_issues_reached' = max_issues_per_run limit hit; 'kill_switch' = status:kill label detected; 'no_status_less_issues' = backlog exhausted in one-shot mode (permanent terminal — no more issues to groom); 'watch_poll_wait' = transient terminal — groomer is entering a WATCH-mode sleep cycle and will re-check after poll_interval (re-check scheduled, not a permanent stop).

failure_reason.description: Required when groom_status=failed. Describes the operational or budget failure that prevented grooming completion. Must NOT be used when groom_status is ready, blocked, skipped, or terminal. minLength:1 ensures the string is non-empty.

recommended_next_step.description: Specific recommendation for what should happen next (human reviewer, implementer agent, or groomer re-run).
